name: Oahu (Honolulu + Waikiki), Hawaii
tagline: Waikiki beaches, Pearl Harbor, North Shore surf
whyParents: Easy first Hawaii trip: walkable beach town, deep WWII history, big-wave surf season on the North Shore.

costPP.flightsBasis: AA one-stop PHL-HNL via DFW/PHX/LAX/ORD; aa.com shows PHL-HNL round trip from $658 (other months); mid-Dec estimate $650 to $800
costPP.lodgingBasis: Waikiki 2BR condo ~$400/night all-in x 6 nights = ~$2,400 split 4 ways (2 hotel rooms at Oahu ADR ~$264 = ~$900 pp)
costPP.foodFunBasis: ~$85/day food, Kualoa/Hanauma fees, 3-day SUV ~$500 total + Waikiki parking ~$50/night

flight.routing: PHL-DFW-HNL or PHL-PHX-HNL (AA, one stop); no AA nonstop PHL-HNL found
flight.notes: Alt: Hawaiian/Alaska JFK-HNL nonstop (~11h, daily per aggregators; Dec unverified). Book JFK-HNL on Alaska or with Capital One Travel.

weather.precip: short passing showers, wetter on windward side; big North Shore surf

stay: Waikiki (Kuhio Ave side): walk to beach, food, no car needed
getAround: Walk/TheBus/Uber in Honolulu. Rent a full-size SUV or minivan 3 days for North Shore and windward coast.
entry: US domestic: no passport. REAL ID or passport for TSA.
events: Honolulu Marathon: Sun Dec 13 2026, 5am start Ala Moana Blvd, finish Kapiolani Park; Waikiki road closures that morning
Kalakaua Merrie Mile: Sat Dec 12 2026, 7am, Monsarrat Ave (marathon weekend)
Honolulu City Lights: opened Sat Dec 5 2026; tree and displays at Honolulu Hale through the holidays (end date unverified)
North Shore big-wave season: Waimea Bay surf contests possible if swell is large (dates set by swell)
pros: Most flights and cheapest lodging in Hawaii
Walkable Waikiki, car only needed some days
Pearl Harbor and Iolani Palace history
cons: Long travel day, about 14 hours each way
Hanauma Bay needs advance online reservations

itinerary.title: Arrive + Waikiki sunset
itinerary.plan: Land HNL, check in Waikiki condo, stroll Kalakaua Ave and the beach at sunset.

itinerary.title: Diamond Head sunrise hike
itinerary.plan: Reserved early slot up Diamond Head, then Kapahulu and Kapiolani Park. Watch marathon finish if Dec 13.

itinerary.title: Pearl Harbor
itinerary.plan: Book USS Arizona Memorial timed tickets; add Battleship Missouri. Afternoon Iolani Palace and City Lights.

itinerary.title: North Shore day
itinerary.plan: Pick up SUV. Haleiwa town, Waimea Bay big surf, turtles at Laniakea, Sunset Beach.

itinerary.title: Windward coast + Kualoa
itinerary.plan: Kualoa Ranch valley tour, Kailua and Lanikai beaches, Pali Lookout drive back.
itinerary.eat: Shave ice at Island Snow, Kailua

itinerary.title: Hanauma Bay snorkel
itinerary.plan: Reserved morning snorkel at Hanauma Bay, then Makapuu lighthouse trail views. Last Waikiki sunset.

itinerary.title: Fly home
itinerary.plan: Beach morning, return car, afternoon or red-eye flight to PHL.
itinerary.eat: Spam musubi from a local market

name: Maui, Hawaii
tagline: Haleakala sunrise, Road to Hana, whale season
whyParents: Classic Hawaii scenery: volcano sunrise, waterfall drive, calm snorkel coves, first humpback whales of season.

costPP.flightsBasis: AA one-stop PHL-OGG via DFW/PHX/LAX; typical mid-Dec range $700 to $900. New AA ORD-OGG daily from Dec 17 2026 helps the return
costPP.lodgingBasis: Kihei 2BR condo ~$450/night all-in x 6 = ~$2,700 split 4 ways (Maui hotel ADR ~$494/room)
costPP.foodFunBasis: ~$95/day food, Molokini boat ~$150, Haleakala sunrise reservation + park fee, 6-day full-size SUV ~$1,000 split 4

flight.routing: PHL-DFW-OGG or PHL-LAX-OGG (AA, one stop); return OGG-ORD-PHL possible (AA ORD-OGG daily from Dec 17 2026)
flight.notes: Alt: Hawaiian/Alaska JFK-HNL nonstop + short interisland hop to OGG.

weather.precip: dry in Kihei/Wailea, showers in Hana; Haleakala summit near freezing at dawn

stay: Kihei: cheaper condos, calm beaches, central location
getAround: Car essential. Full-size SUV or minivan for 4 adults + bags; Road to Hana is narrow, drive slowly.
entry: US domestic: no passport. REAL ID or passport for TSA.
events: Lahaina: Front Street scheduled to reopen to vehicles Aug 1 2026 with some businesses back; many lots still empty; respect fenced areas
Lahaina Harbor dredging Jun to Dec 2026; harbor not fully reopened, book boats from Maalaea
Humpback whale season starting (Dec to Apr)
American Airlines Chicago-Kahului daily nonstop launches Dec 17 2026
pros: Most dramatic scenery of the four islands

itinerary.title: Arrive + Kihei beach
itinerary.plan: Land OGG, pick up SUV, groceries, sunset at Kamaole Beach III.
itinerary.eat: Fish tacos at Coconut's Fish Cafe

itinerary.title: Haleakala sunrise
itinerary.plan: 3am drive with sunrise reservation; short Sliding Sands walk; Kula lunch on the way down.

itinerary.title: Road to Hana
itinerary.plan: Early start: Twin Falls, Waianapanapa (reservation), Wailua Falls; turn back before dark.

itinerary.title: Molokini + whales
itinerary.plan: Morning snorkel boat from Maalaea to Molokini, watch for early humpbacks. Afternoon nap.

itinerary.title: Iao Valley + stargazing
itinerary.plan: Iao Valley State Monument, Wailuku lunch, then Haleakala summit sunset and stars.

itinerary.title: West Maui + Lahaina
itinerary.plan: Respectful drive past reopened Front Street, Kaanapali beach walk, Kapalua coastal trail.

itinerary.title: Fly home
itinerary.plan: Paia breakfast, Hookipa turtles, return car, fly OGG.

name: Big Island: Kona + Volcano, Hawaii
tagline: Live volcano, black sand, Kona coffee
whyParents: See an active volcano, swim with turtles and manta rays, tour Kona coffee farms; most varied island.

costPP.flightsBasis: AA one-stop PHL-KOA via PHX (daily PHX-KOA) or LAX; typical mid-Dec $700 to $950
costPP.lodgingBasis: Kona 2BR condo ~$300/night x 4 + Volcano 2BR cottage ~$250/night x 2 = ~$1,700 split 4 ways
costPP.foodFunBasis: ~$80/day food, Volcanoes park vehicle fee, manta night snorkel ~$150, 6-day full-size SUV ~$1,000 split 4

flight.routing: PHL-PHX-KOA (AA, one stop; PHX-KOA daily per schedule data)
flight.notes: Alt: JFK-HNL nonstop (Hawaiian/Alaska) + 45 min hop to KOA or Hilo.

weather.precip: Kona dry and sunny; Volcano village ~65F high, ~50F nights, misty rain; Hilo wet

stay: Kailua-Kona condo for sun, Volcano village cottage for lava
getAround: Car essential, long drives (Kona to Volcano ~2.5h). Full-size SUV or minivan for 4 adults + bags.
entry: US domestic: no passport. REAL ID or passport for TSA.
events: Kilauea: episodic summit lava fountains continue; episode 55 on Oct 17 2026 reached ~700 ft after a 2-month pause. Another episode during the trip is possible, not guaranteed
Fountain episodes can close parts of Volcanoes National Park and bring ashfall; check USGS HVO daily
Kailua-Kona Christmas Parade: usually 2nd Saturday of Dec (Dec 14 2024, Dec 13 2025), likely Sat Dec 12 2026 (unverified)
pros: Chance to see live lava glow
cons: Volcano area is cool and rainy

itinerary.title: Arrive Kona
itinerary.plan: Land KOA, pick up SUV, settle in Kailua-Kona, sunset walk on Alii Drive.
itinerary.eat: Fish and chips at Splasher's Grill

itinerary.title: Kealakekua Bay snorkel
itinerary.plan: Boat or guided kayak to Captain Cook Monument reef. Evening manta ray night snorkel.

itinerary.title: Place of Refuge + coffee
itinerary.plan: Puuhonua o Honaunau historic park, Two Step snorkel, Kona coffee farm tour.
itinerary.eat: Kalua pork plate at Da Poke Shack

itinerary.title: South Point to Volcano
itinerary.plan: Drive south; turtles at Punaluu black sand beach; check in Volcano; night crater glow if active.

itinerary.title: Volcanoes National Park
itinerary.plan: Kilauea overlooks, Nahuku lava tube, Chain of Craters Road to sea arch.
itinerary.eat: Volcano House lunch over the caldera

itinerary.title: Hilo + Maunakea
itinerary.plan: Hilo farmers market, Akaka Falls, Saddle Road to Maunakea Visitor Station stars, back to Kona.

itinerary.title: Fly home
itinerary.plan: Last beach swim, coffee to pack, return SUV, fly KOA.

name: Kauai, Hawaii
tagline: Na Pali cliffs, Waimea Canyon, quiet beaches
whyParents: Greenest, calmest island: dramatic cliffs by boat, canyon views, monk seals on the beach, little traffic.

costPP.flightsBasis: AA one-stop PHL-LIH via LAX (or PHX); typical mid-Dec $700 to $950
costPP.lodgingBasis: Poipu 2BR condo ~$425/night all-in x 6 = ~$2,550 split 4 ways (Kauai hotel ADR ~$409/room)
costPP.foodFunBasis: ~$85/day food, Na Pali boat tour ~$200, kayak ~$80, 6-day full-size SUV ~$1,000 split 4

flight.routing: PHL-LAX-LIH (AA, one stop); LIH nonstops limited, check PHX/DFW
flight.notes: Alt: JFK-HNL nonstop (Hawaiian/Alaska) + 35 min hop to LIH.

weather.precip: wettest island in Dec; south shore (Poipu) sunniest; north shore rain and big surf

stay: Poipu: sunniest coast, beaches, monk seals
getAround: Car essential; one main highway. Full-size SUV or minivan for 4 adults + bags.
entry: US domestic: no passport. REAL ID or passport for TSA.
events: Lights on Rice Parade, Lihue: Fri Dec 4 2026 (before trip); Kauai Festival of Lights displays usually up through New Year (2026 run unverified)
North Shore winter surf: Na Pali boat tours may be rerouted or canceled in big swell
pros: Na Pali Coast is world class
Poipu sun with monk seal sightings

itinerary.title: Arrive + Poipu Beach
itinerary.plan: Land LIH, pick up SUV, 30 min to Poipu, sunset at Poipu Beach Park.
itinerary.eat: Fish tacos at Da Crack, Koloa

itinerary.title: Waimea Canyon
itinerary.plan: Drive up Waimea Canyon to Kalalau Lookout; stop in Waimea town on the way back.

itinerary.title: Na Pali by boat
itinerary.plan: Morning catamaran from Port Allen along Na Pali sea caves; snorkel if calm.

itinerary.title: North Shore + Hanalei
itinerary.plan: Kilauea Point lighthouse, Hanalei Bay pier, Tunnels/Haena views (Haena park needs reservation).

itinerary.title: Wailua River
itinerary.plan: Guided Wailua River kayak to Secret Falls or boat to Fern Grotto; Wailua Falls overlook.

itinerary.title: South shore slow day
itinerary.plan: Mahaulepu coastal walk, Spouting Horn, Allerton or McBryde garden tour, Koloa town.

itinerary.title: Fly home
itinerary.plan: Beach morning, return SUV at LIH, fly home.

name: Oahu + Maui combo, Hawaii
tagline: Two islands: Waikiki history, Maui scenery
whyParents: Best of both: Pearl Harbor and Waikiki, then Haleakala sunrise and Road to Hana.

costPP.flightsBasis: AA open-jaw PHL-HNL, OGG-PHL est. $750 to $800 + interisland HNL-OGG ~$70 to $100 (Southwest from $69 one way, 2026 snapshot) + $30 bag
costPP.lodgingBasis: Waikiki 2BR ~$400 x 3 nights + Kihei 2BR ~$450 x 3 nights = ~$2,550 split 4 ways
costPP.foodFunBasis: ~$90/day food, Haleakala fees, Pearl Harbor, SUV on Maui 3 days ~$500 + Oahu 1 day ~$150 split 4

flight.routing: PHL-DFW-HNL out; OGG-ORD-PHL back (AA ORD-OGG daily from Dec 17 2026) or OGG-DFW-PHL; HNL-OGG on Southwest or Hawaiian
flight.notes: Interisland: Southwest or Hawaiian, ~40 min, many daily. Interisland bag fees rose Apr 9 2026 ($30 first bag).

weather.precip: mostly sunny leeward sides, passing showers; Haleakala summit near freezing at dawn

stay: Waikiki condo 3 nights, then Kihei condo 3 nights
getAround: Oahu: walk/Uber, 1-day car. Maui: full-size SUV or minivan for 4 adults + bags.
entry: US domestic: no passport. REAL ID or passport for TSA.
events: Honolulu Marathon: Sun Dec 13 2026; Waikiki road closures early morning
Honolulu City Lights at Honolulu Hale (opened Dec 5 2026)

Humpback whale season starting on Maui
